title: How to Ask an AI Assistant to Check Its Own Work Before You Use It
facebook: A simple two-prompt trick catches AI mistakes: first get your answer, then ask the assistant to list its assumptions and re-check each step. Works for plans, math and drafts. https://aiworldhq.com/article/how-to-ask-an-ai-assistant-to-check-its-own-work-before-you-use-it
